notices.title: GGSIPU Odd Semester End-Term Theory & Practical Examination Date Sheet (Dec 2026)
notices.summary: Comprehensive date sheet for 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th semester B.Tech and MBA theory and lab examinations issued under GGSIPU Examination Branch guidelines.
fullContent: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) has formally notified the date sheet for the upcoming End-Term Theory and Practical Examinations for the Odd Semesters of the Academic Session 2026–2027.
All regular and reappear candidates are instructed to verify their registered paper codes against the official university roster.
Hall tickets and student admit cards with verified seating plans will be disbursed via the Department Examination Incharges starting 20 November 2026.

Students must carry their official institutional identity card alongside the printed university admit card. Electronic gadgets, programmable calculators, and mobile phones are strictly prohibited in the examination halls.

notices.title: Campus Recruitment Drive: Atlassian, DE Shaw & Amazon Shortlisting Circular
notices.summary: Interview schedules, system design rounds, and physical reporting times for registered final year B.Tech students in Block 2 Computing Labs.
fullContent: The Training and Placement Cell hereby announces the shortlisting result for the technical rounds of Atlassian, D.E. Shaw & Co., and Amazon Web Services.
Shortlisted candidates must report to the Computing Labs in Aryabhatta Block (Block 2) sharply at 08:30 AM in formal collegiate attire with three sets of updated resumes and college photo IDs.
A pre-placement orientation briefing will be conducted in the Block 9 Convention Auditorium prior to technical interview breakouts.
notices.issuer: Brig. S. K. Sharma / Prof. Vaibhav Jain

notices.title: Delhi Govt e-District Merit-cum-Means Financial Assistance Scheme 2026–27
notices.summary: Guidelines, mandatory document checklist, and physical verification deadlines for Delhi state financial assistance across 3 verified economic income slabs.
fullContent: Applications are invited from eligible undergraduate engineering and management students for financial assistance under the Delhi Government Higher Education Merit-cum-Means scheme.

Eligibility Slabs: Category 1 (100% waiver for NFSA cardholders); Category 2 (50% assistance for annual household income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs); Category 3 (25% assistance for household income ₹2.5 Lakhs to ₹6.0 Lakhs).

All applicants must submit hard copies of their acknowledged online portal receipt, bank passbook, income certificate issued by SDM, and 12th/previous semester grade cards to the Accounts Branch (Block 1) by 15 November 2026.

notices.title: Admissions 2026: Spot Round Physical Reporting & Seat Regularization Guidelines
notices.summary: Physical reporting schedule, fee balance draft instructions, and original document verification protocol for candidates allocated seats via GGSIPU Spot Counseling.
fullContent: Candidates allotted seats at Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology in the GGSIPU Spot Round counseling are directed to report in person at the Block 1 Auditorium Lobby.

Candidates must bring original 10th and 12th marksheets, JEE Main 2026 Admit Card and Scorecard, GGSIPU Allotment Letter, Medical Fitness Certificate (Appendix 6), Character Certificate, and category certificates (if applicable).
Balance institute fee of ₹89,000/- must be submitted via Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology" payable at New Delhi.

notices.title: Commencement of Mid-Term Minor Examinations (All B.Tech Programs)
notices.summary: Detailed seating matrix, slot schedules, and centralized evaluation guidelines for 1st minor assessment across Engineering Departments.
fullContent: The Academic Section notifies that the 1st Minor Assessment Examinations for 3rd, 5th, and 7th Semester B.Tech programs shall be conducted as per the published schedule.
Attendance in the minor evaluations carries mandatory internal weightage as mandated by GGSIPU CBCS Regulations.
Question papers are set by respective subject teachers and moderated by departmental review committees.

notices.title: Call for Proposals: Student Startup Seed Grant (Up to ₹2.5 Lakhs) under MAIIF Incubator
notices.summary: Application window opened for hardware and software prototypes by Maharaja Agrasen Innovation and Incubation Foundation under MoE Innovation Cell.
fullContent: MAIIF (Maharaja Agrasen Innovation & Incubation Foundation), a Section 8 non-profit company registered under MATES, invites disruptive technology prototype proposals.
Selected student and faculty teams will receive seed funding grants of up to ₹2,50,000/-, complimentary incubation workspace in Block 4, legal incorporation guidance, and IP filing assistance.
Eligible domains include AI/ML Edge Computing, CleanTech, EV Powertrains, MedTech, and Autonomous Robotics.

notices.title: Annual Subject Registration & Elective Selection Portal Window for Spring 2027
notices.summary: Instructions for selecting Open Electives, Program Electives, and NPTEL/Swayam online credit transfer courses for upcoming semester.
fullContent: All continuing students of B.Tech 4th, 6th, and 8th semesters must complete their elective subject preferences via their departmental academic mentors.
Students opting for MOOCs on SWAYAM/NPTEL for credit transfer must ensure the selected course appears in the AICTE/GGSIPU approved basket.

notices.title: TechSurge & Mridang 2027: Core Student Organizing Committee Selections
notices.summary: Auditions and portfolio screening for technical leads, sponsorship coordinators, and creative designers for MAIT’s flagship annual festival.
fullContent: The Cultural Affairs & Student Welfare Committee announces open recruitment for the Central Organizing Committee of TechSurge & Mridang 2027.
Interviews will take place in the Block 9 Convention Auditorium Foyer on 04 and 05 November 2026.

notices.title: Hostel Resident Re-Allotment & Mess Facility Advisory for Winter Term
notices.summary: Mess menu revisions, room inspection protocols, and fee clearance reminders for residents of the on-campus Boys Hostel.
fullContent: Hostel residents are notified that winter dining hours commence 01 November 2026. The Mess Committee has approved updated balanced nutritional menus.
Residents must verify that their mess dues and second-installment hostel fees are cleared before the end-term examination break.

notices.title: Dr. Nand Kishore Garg Central Library: Book Bank Issue Schedule for Odd Semesters
notices.summary: Semester-long textbook loan scheme dates branch-wise for B.Tech students in Block 8 Library building.
fullContent: The Central Library announces the distribution schedule for the 100% Student Book Bank Lending Scheme.
CSE & IT: Monday & Tuesday | ECE & EEE: Wednesday | MAE & Allied branches: Thursday & Friday. Each student receives 5-6 prescribed textbooks for the complete semester.
notices.issuerDesignation: Dr. Nand Kishore Garg Central Library

notices.title: Statutory Compliance: Zero-Tolerance Policy on Ragging & Student Grievance Redressal
notices.summary: Mandatory anti-ragging declaration under UGC/AICTE norms, squad contacts, and round-the-clock helpline access.
fullContent: As per UGC Regulations on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, MAIT maintains an uncompromising Zero-Tolerance stance.

Students and parents must submit the annual online anti-ragging undertaking at www.antiragging.in. Toll-Free Anti-Ragging Helpline: 1800-180-5522. Institutional Proctorial Board numbers are posted across all campus gates.

notices.title: Archived: GGSIPU Even Semester 2025 Supplementary Examination Result Gazette
notices.summary: Final tabulated notification for even semester 2024–2025 re-appear examinations.
fullContent: GGSIPU Examination Branch has released the supplementary and re-evaluation results for the Even Semester examinations held in May–June 2025.
Students may collect consolidated grade cards from their respective department academic offices.

events.title: TechSurge & Mridang 2027 — Annual Techno-Cultural Festival
events.tagline: Delhi-NCR’s premier 3-day collegiate festival with 15,000+ footfall and ₹12L+ in cash prize pools.
events.description: TechSurge & Mridang is the flagship annual carnival of Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology. Integrating competitive robotics, hackathons, literary debates, musical band wars, western dance battles, and a live celebrity star-night, the fest brings together top talent from premier institutes across India.
events.venue: Main Campus Quadrangle, Auditorium (Block 9) & Sports Arena

events.title: HackMAIT 5.0 — 48-Hour National Hackathon
events.tagline: Innovate at scale in AI/ML, Web3, CleanTech, and Assistive Robotics with top industry mentors.
events.description: HackMAIT is the annual national 48-hour student hackathon jointly organized by ACM MAIT and IEEE MAIT Student Branches. Teams pitch, prototype, and build production-ready applications with round-the-clock mentorship from senior software engineers at Google, Amazon, and Microsoft.

events.description: Team Defianz Racing unveils their latest aerodynamic chassis, telemetry telemetry package, and powertrain built in-house at the MAIT Mechanical Workshops. The unveiling features live static scrutiny demonstrations and driver interviews ahead of Formula Bharat.

events.tagline: Intense autonomous robotics and RC bot battles organized by IEEE Robotics SIG.
events.description: A 2-day high-octane robotics competition where collegiate robotics enthusiasts battle in customized Arenas. Tracks include high-speed PID line tracking, pick-and-place maze solvers, and custom 5kg wireless soccer bots.

events.description: Organized under the patronage of Maharaja Agrasen Innovation and Incubation Foundation. 15 shortlisted student startups present working demos and business plans to venture funds and angel networks for pre-seed investments up to ₹25 Lakhs.

events.title: Rangmanch: Aaveg Dramatics Annual Street Play Showcase
events.tagline: Award-winning national street theatre performances tackling burning contemporary social themes.
events.description: Aaveg, MAIT’s nationally renowned street theatre society, performs its latest original production following victories at IIT Delhi Rendezvous and BITS Pilani Oasis. Features raw percussion, vocal harmony, and intense street play dramatics.

events.description: 3-day technical boot camp conducted by certified AWS solutions architects. Covers EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, and fine-tuning open models using AWS SageMaker with AWS credits provided to all attendees.
